'''Imperial Garrison Headquarters''' was the main [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]], located in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was relatively small, manned by three hundred [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|troops]] with attendant vehicles and supplies to last for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Game" />

The structure was used in the early days of the Ord Mynock Freeport to house the initial communications team the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent to the planet. Since then, the Empire modified the facility with several additional levels for barracks, vehicle motor pool, and a landing pad on the roof large enough to accommodate a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. The base was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lyal Frel]].<ref name="Game" />
